messages:
maya: Nightly eval alerted: KBQA promptset failure spike on rwk-13b-int8-v2. Exact: EM down 78.4 -> 61.2, median gen length -5 tokens, stopseq early-termination +11.2% abs. Gate tripped on canary.
zane: I saw the dashboard. Linking: https://dash.internal/redwood/nightly/173555. eval-bot: nightly-eval job #173555 ran at 03:12 UTC — gating rule failed for 'kbqa-long' (threshold breached).
maya: Examples show outputs ending abruptly: many answers are a single token like "yes" or "no" with missing span. Logs show EOS prob jump mid-seq.
alex: Any deploys or config changes around the canary? deploy-bot: promoted rwk-13b-int8-v2 -> canary @ 1735548000 (commit a1b2c3). No infra changes.
oah: Quick diff of PTQ pipeline: new quant-config set `fold_layernorm: true` and switched per-channel scale heuristics. Suspect LN folding interacting with last-token logits.
sri: Also saw earlier tokenizer bump in staging (tokenizers 0.12.5) but not yet in prod. Could be a red herring.
eva: I can repro locally with small harness. Snippet:
```
# reproduce
out = infer(model='rwk-13b-int8-v2', prompt='Who wrote the book about X?')
# many outputs: "John" then EOS immediately
```
maya: Hypothesis: PTQ layernorm folding changed numeric distribution at final layer causing eos token logit to become relatively more likely for many prompts — manifests as early stopseq.
zane: Action plan immediate: 1) rollback canary to rwk-13b-int8-v1, 2) add a gating rule to nightly/canary that blocks int8 variants with >5% absolute stopseq early-term increase, 3) add unit test for median length delta and stopseq rate, 4) run ablation on fold_layernorm.
alex: I'll do rollback now. curl command to move alias:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood/v1/models/rwk-13b/alias \
  -d '{"alias":"canary","version":"rwk-13b-int8-v1"}' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY"
```
maya: Assignments: alex -> rollback (ETA +15m), zane -> gating + test, noah -> ablation (disable LN folding), sri -> confirm tokenizer not culprit, eva -> expand synthetic KBQA prompts in nightly.
noah: Ablation update: disabling fold_layernorm in PTQ on local reproduces the old behavior (EM back to 77-79, early-term drop back to baseline). This points to LN folding as primary cause.
sri: Verified tokenizer: vendor changelog indicates no behavioral change for trailing space/norm in our tokenizer version. marking tokenizer as ruled out.
zane: PR for gating rule and unit tests created: https://git.redwood/pr/4821 (ci-bot: tests passed on headless). ci-bot: gating rule merged to main and scheduled on nightly-2 at 03:00 UTC.
eva: Added 120 synthetic long-KBQA prompts to nightly and a targeted stopseq-rate check. Also added one-shot examples to ensure spans are preserved.
maya: Mitigation summary & timeline:
- 03:12 UTC: Nightly alert raised (this thread). 
- 03:25 UTC: rollback executed (alex) -> canary moved to rwk-13b-int8-v1.
- 04:10 UTC: LN-folding ablation confirmed reducing early-term (noah).
- 05:00 UTC: gating rule + tests merged (zane, ci-bot).
- 06:20 UTC: synthetic prompts + extra checks added to nightly (eva).
Follow-ups:
- noah will produce a calibrated PTQ run that keeps LN folding but applies per-layer compensation (ETA end of week).
- zane will coordinate a canary re-roll only after ablation + compensated quant scales and running extended nightly checks (block until stopseq delta <2% and EM within 1.5 points).
maya: Root cause (tentative): interaction between fold_layernorm PTQ optimization and the final token logits. Folding changed numerical bias in final projection such that EOS logit increases for many contexts, resulting in early termination. Secondary investigation into per-channel scaling heuristics is ongoing.
zane: Longer term checks: add stopseq-rate into canary SLOs, add synthetic adversarial prompts for token-boundary-sensitive tasks, and require ablation report as part of PTQ rollout checklist.
alex: Closing this canary incident. Filing postmortem doc and action items in GH: https://git.redwood/issue/ML-PTQ-238
maya: Thanks all. Owners: alex (rollback), noah (fix), zane (gating/tests), eva (nightly augment). :white_check_mark:
